title: mail-server: metadata-04 /get defaults+subselectors, /copy overrides
description: Follow-up from JMAP-s4kp.1 (which wired /query, /changes, /set only, per its three points). Remaining draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-04 gaps for opted-in Email/Mailbox in jmap-mail-server: (1) §3.1 /get: for Mailbox/get with properties null and using containing urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata, include metadata (Email/get defaults unchanged); §2 'When returned, its value MUST be an object ({} when no metadata is set), never null' — today an object with no stored metadata omits it; and metadata/<namespace> subselectors (union, root supersedes, malformed -> invalidArguments, unsupported namespace omitted unless data stored). (2) §3.4 Email/copy: the create MAY override metadata with Foo/set create rules; without the capability only metadata is copied. (3) §3: /query evaluates metadata conditions regardless of using; strictly the §3.6 extension applies only to requests using the capability (QueryParams carries no using).
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
